caption: Brian Trematore Plumbing & Heating, Inc. v. Sheet Metal Workers Local Union 25
citation_line: Brian Trematore Plumbing & Heating, Inc. v. Sheet Metal Workers Local Union 25, No. 24-1298 (3d Cir. Aug. 1, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Martinotti held that the contractor had not effectively repudiated its collective-bargaining agreement and compelled arbitration of the disputed grievances.
qualification_rationale: The case addresses the intersection of § 9(a) collective-bargaining relationships, construction-industry labor agreements and the NLRB’s one-employee-unit doctrine—an issue on which the appellate panel divided in part.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in a precedential opinion, holding that the attempted repudiation was ineffective and that the CBA remained in effect.
